shots.name: lax_touchdown_bird
shots.pos: const M = en.sky.model, a = M.airports.LAX, e = M.runway('LAX', '24R'); return M.along(a, e, e.displ + 330, -90);
shots.js: const k = en.sky, M = k.model; k.hold(null); const t = k.now(), b = Math.floor(t / 3600); const f = M.arrivals('LAX', b).concat(M.arrivals('LAX', b + 1)).filter(f => f.rw === '24R' && f.t0 > t + 30)[0]; k.hold(f.t0 + 5.5); return f.type.key;
shots.check: const k = en.sky, f = k.flights.filter(p => p.kind === 'arr' && p.f.rw === '24R').sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.dist) - Math.abs(b.dist))[0]; return f ? { type: f.f.type.key, phase: f.phase, y: +f.y.toFixed(1), past_threshold_m: Math.round(-f.dist), shadows: Object.keys(k.model.TYPES).length } : null;

Array.from(k.lampSet.ib.data.slice(0, 16)).map(v => +v.toFixed(1)) : null, cam: Array.from(en.engine.camera.entity.transform.position).map(v => +v.toFixed(0)) };

shots.name: vincent_thomas
shots.check: const d = en.sky.decks.find(x => x.name === 'Vincent Thomas Bridge'), K = d.loc.K, t = en.sky.tools, s = (K.W + K.E) / 2, p = t.pointAt(d, s); return { towers: Math.round(K.E - K.W), mid: +en.world.deckAt(p.x, p.z).toFixed(1), L: Math.round(d.loc.L) };
